source.conversion: Computed: No roster lists the season's players, so each school's are rebuilt: those with a box-score line for it, the recruits it signed in the season's class or the four before whom a later season places there again, and those of the season's class or the one before whom no record places elsewhere; a school still short of a starting place takes its other such recruits at that position; each position is then read as if every school carried College Football 27's depth there, the players the rebuild cannot name ranking below all it can. each player's value is a weighted sum of standardised signals of his position (their share of their school's passes, carries and catches, their yards, interceptions and field goals (plays before 2014 name no tacklers), his 247Sports recruiting grade and his years in college), pooled over 2006 and the two seasons before it 3:2:1; the weights were fitted to College Football 27's launch ratings of the players of 2025 who returned in 2026 and frozen. Each school's best at each position (College Football 27's depth) are ranked across the season's FBS schools and read off College Football 27's ratings at that position (Week 10 Ratings). Each school then moves toward its results: its Simple Rating System over the season's games between FBS schools (reliability 0.887), times √reliability ÷ 3.926 points a game per point of played strength, about the schools' mean 79.99; every player of the school by a whole number and its best few one more, never reordered.
